summaryEn: Wang Ba was born in 777 during the Tang dynasty.
description: 王霸出生于唐代（618—907年），这是中国历史上文化繁荣、国力强盛的时期。
descriptionEn: Wang Ba was born during the Tang dynasty (618-907).
